summary: Gold X2 Mining Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on NYSE American and TSXV, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated October 14, 2026, reporting assay results from its ongoing infill drilling program at the Moss Gold Project in Northwest Ontario. Twenty-one holes tested the Main and Southwest Zones, returning intercepts including 172.0m of 0.96 g/t Au. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, activist, or capital-structure event is disclosed. The company targets an updated Mineral Resource Estimate in Q1 2027. This is a routine exploration update, not a special situation; monitor resource conversion and strip-ratio improvements.
